description: This file declares the SetupElement class, which is a task for setting up a media element within a generic player context. It includes class members for managing dependencies such as wrappers and the media element itself, and defines the execute method for performing the setup.

classes.name: SetupElement
classes.description: A class representing a task to set up a media element within the generic player context, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: SetupElement
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SetupElement with the given context, wrappers, player, and media element.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the setup operation for the media element.
